Hymn 36: They, the Builders of the Nation
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Alfred M. Durham
Lyricist/Text Author: Ida R. Alldredge
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 36 titled "They, the Builders of the Nation" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Alfred M. Durham and the lyrics were written by Ida R. Alldredge.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
